purpose: Teach: ひっかかっ/手ごろ/めでたし/微塵/多けれ/ともども/気長/なめらか

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の鞄が机にひっかかってんぞ
lines.en: Riku, your bag's snagged on the desk.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact observation. Quick delivery, no fuss. The tone of someone pointing out a practical problem without making it a bigger deal than it is.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、手ごろな参考書見つけたな、桜
lines.en: You found a decent study guide, huh Sakura?
lines.style: Genuinely impressed, slightly surprised. Soft warmth in the recognition. Not mocking — real acknowledgment that she's stepping up. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のテスト点、めでたし結果だったな
lines.en: Riku, your test scores came back pretty solid.
lines.style: Warm, genuine approval. Not overdoing it — delivering the fact with a slight lift, like it matters to her that he did well. Understated pride.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強する気微塵もないだろ、桜
lines.en: You don't have the slightest motivation to study, do you Sakura?
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. A knowing half-smile in the voice. Not harsh — pointing out something they both recognize as true about her. Affectionate wryness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画多ければ多いほど集めたいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, the more manga you find, the more you want to collect it, don't you?
lines.style: Curious, slightly playful questioning. Noticing his pattern without judgment. The tone of someone asking a question she already knows the answer to, just to see him confirm it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族ともども旅行に行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You took a trip with your family, didn't you Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, inviting her to share. A question that opens the door rather than interrogates. Warm interest in her world.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、気長に勉強しろよ
lines.en: Riku, take your time with it — just keep studying.
lines.style: Steady, encouraging tone. Not demanding, but firm underneath. The reassurance that steady effort matters. Steady pace, supportive close.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ダンスがなめらかになったな、桜
lines.en: Your dancing's gotten a lot smoother, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct compliment, genuine notice. Quiet sincerity. Not lavish — just stating what he's observed. The kind of praise that lands because it's specific and real.
